title: Noticeable · adj.
subtitle: 「明顯的／可見的／容易察覺的／顯眼的」，究竟是哪一種 noticeable？
description: 「明顯的／可見的／容易察覺的／顯眼的」，究竟是哪一種 noticeable？

words.note: 使用者提供。obvious 比一般 noticeable 更強，表示某事非常容易看出、理解或察覺，幾乎不需要仔細觀察。它常用於 errors, differences, reasons, signs。
words.example: There was an obvious difference between the two versions.

exercises.original: The change was noticeable immediately, even to people who had not seen the earlier version.
exercises.zh: 這個改變立即就很明顯，即使沒有看過舊版本的人也能察覺。
exercises.upgrade: obvious · 明顯的；顯而易見的

options.explanation: immediately + easy recognition by uninformed observers makes the change more than merely noticeable.
只表示肉眼可見，常與 crack, mark, scar, light 搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 a difference that is immediately clear；這裡需要的是「非常清楚、立即可察覺」。因此 visible 雖與 noticeable 有重疊，但是否限於視覺、是否需要高度顯眼、是否可透過儀器察覺，或是否強調正式的顯著變化並不最吻合。
較正式，常表示某變化、差異或狀況從跡象中變得明顯。 本題的決定性線索是 a difference that is immediately clear；這裡需要的是「非常清楚、立即可察覺」。因此 apparent 雖與 noticeable 有重疊，但是否限於視覺、是否需要高度顯眼、是否可透過儀器察覺，或是否強調正式的顯著變化並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: obvious 通常比 noticeable 強，表示幾乎不用仔細看便能察覺；noticeable 只需足以被注意到。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The error was obvious. There was a noticeable change in tone.

falseSynonyms.zh: visible 只表示看得見；noticeable 可以是聲音、氣味、溫度、感覺或統計變化。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A crack was visible. There was a noticeable smell.

falseSynonyms.zh: apparent 較正式，常表示從跡象上看得出某事；noticeable 更中性、更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The improvement became apparent. The noise was noticeable.

falseSynonyms.zh: conspicuous 更強，表示很顯眼、從背景中突出；普通 noticeable 未必如此突出。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The red coat was conspicuous. The colour difference was noticeable.

falseSynonyms.zh: perceptible 較正式，可表示很細微但仍能感知；noticeable 通常更容易引起注意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A slight tremor was perceptible. The change was noticeable.

falseSynonyms.zh: marked 常用於正式的 improvement/decline/contrast 等顯著變化；不是一般任何可見物都能用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There was a marked decline in errors. A scratch was noticeable on the surface.

falseSynonyms.zh: detectable 只需能被檢測到，可能需要儀器；noticeable 通常意味人較容易察覺。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The substance is detectable at very low levels. The smell was noticeable.

falseSynonyms.zh: noticeable 是形容詞；notice 可作動詞或名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The change was noticeable. I noticed the change.
